baseline_models.focus_anchor: قَسَمٌ at 89:5.4 as an oath and حِجْرٍ at 89:5.6 as reason whose defining action is restraint.
baseline_models.mechanism: The interrogative joins an oath-speech-act to a qualified recipient: the oath becomes probative only for a faculty that can keep improper inference and action back. Intelligence is therefore functional and ethical, not merely informational.

activation_trace.role: The oath apportioned among its holders supplies the utterance's binding evidentiary force.
Reason as a restraining barrier defines the hearer able to receive that force without reckless inference.

changed_reading.before: A conventional rhetorical affirmation that the preceding expressions are an oath for an intelligent person.
changed_reading.after: The question tests whether the hearer possesses an intellect whose operative mark is self-restraint, so receiving the oath is itself an ethical-cognitive act.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The locative فِى ذَٰلِكَ holds قَسَمٌ at 89:5.4 together with the enclosure and boundary possibilities of حِجْرٍ at 89:5.6.
baseline_models.mechanism: If qasam is an apportioning and hijr is a kept boundary, the question asks whether the deictically gathered material contains a legible division. The possessor of hijr is then someone able both to detect and to preserve distinctions.

activation_trace.role: Apportioning a whole into shares turns qasam into an internal division within 'that.'
Keeping back by enclosure makes hijr the capacity to preserve the resulting limits.
The circling boundary mark gives the discerned division a visible perimeter.

changed_reading.before: Qasam names only the speech-act of swearing and hijr is a conventional synonym for intellect.
changed_reading.after: The question can also ask whether 'that' contains a measured partition for one capable of recognizing and keeping boundaries.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: قَسَمٌ at 89:5.4 activates a mind divided among courses while حِجْرٍ at 89:5.6 activates the reason that restrains.
baseline_models.mechanism: The two focus roots form a deliberative loop: an affair divides attention among possible courses, and restraining reason keeps that division from becoming dispersion. The interrogative tests whether the gathered material is sufficient for disciplined choice.

activation_trace.role: A mind divided between courses supplies the open alternatives under deliberation.
Restraining reason contains the alternatives long enough for discriminating judgment.

changed_reading.before: The verse merely asks whether an intelligent audience recognizes an oath.
changed_reading.after: The verse can stage a decision chamber: several courses are held apart and weighed by a reason defined through restraint.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening does not only provide objects to swear by. It repeatedly cuts, counts, pairs, leaves a remainder, and moves a bounded darkness onward. That sequence activates qasam as temporal apportionment and hijr as the boundary faculty that recognizes the architecture.

activation_trace.role: Apportionment supplies the focus mechanism by which one temporal whole becomes distinguishable shares.
A circling boundary supplies the perceptual frame that keeps each temporal share distinct.
Dawn emerging from night supplies the first temporal cut.
Night as darkness supplies the bounded medium being counted and traversed.
Completion of nine by a tenth supplies a closed counted span.
Joining a thing to its like supplies the paired class within the partition.
The singular without a pair supplies the complementary remainder.
Night travel supplies ordered passage across the boundaries just established.

structural_cues: 89:1-4 form a coordinated chain of oath phrases gathered by the singular deictic 'that' in 89:5.
The sequence moves from a cut to a counted span, then paired and unpaired classes, then passage.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies dawn's emergence, a completed count, paired and unpaired units, and night passage; I infer that their ordered recurrence makes the oath a temporal partitioning apparatus. They may alternatively remain separate oath objects without one mathematical mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The opening names several sacred times and then asks whether their oath is sufficient.
changed_reading.after: The opening performs the very qasam it names by apportioning time, while the possessor of hijr is the reader who can perceive its limits and relations.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context constructs an external architecture of columns, measured making, cut rock, and stakes, then shows its makers crossing the limit and leaving sound order. This splits hijr into hard material and inward restraint: those with monumental stone can still lack the inner barrier that makes one truly 'possessed of hijr.'

activation_trace.role: The oath supplies the evidentiary summons under which monumental achievement is tested.
Hard stone supplies the context-facing material sense of hijr.
Reason as restraint supplies the inward counterpart that monumental hardness cannot guarantee.
Columns and supports supply conspicuous external structure.
Measuring and proportioning a thing supplies designed scale rather than accidental bulk.
Penetrating cutting supplies the human ability to open and shape hard material.
Massive hard rock makes the material echo with the focus root explicit.
Driven stakes supply fixation and imposed stability.
Crossing the limit supplies the failure of inward boundary despite external mastery.
Departure from soundness and equilibrium supplies the consequence of failed restraint.
Watchful guarding supplies a final boundary that observes those who would not guard themselves.

structural_cues: The branchless ك ي ف at 89:6 is used only as an interrogative cue: it echoes 89:5's question and opens the historical demonstration.
89:7-10 accumulate built fixtures before 89:11-12 reverse from external order to transgression and corruption.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies supports, measured formation, rock-cutting, stakes, limit-crossing, disorder, and watchfulness; I infer an antithesis between mastered matter and unmastered desire. Alternatively, the building vocabulary may identify powers and their punishment without deliberately redefining hijr.

changed_reading.before: Possessing hijr means simply being intelligent enough to understand the oath.
changed_reading.after: Possessing hijr means having an inward limit: the context exposes the irony that people may command stone, columns, and stakes while lacking the restraint named by the same focus root.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later provision is explicitly an apportioned gift that may be narrowed, while both expansion and constriction are tests. This activates qasam as allotment and hijr as the restraint that blocks a false inference from share-size to personal worth.

activation_trace.role: Apportioning into shares supplies the distributive sense through which provision can reread qasam.
Restraining reason supplies the brake on converting an allotment into a verdict of worth.
Testing that makes a condition visible supplies the correct frame for both economic states.
Honor and praised generosity supply the value category that the human prematurely equates with a large share.
Narrowing something to a small measure supplies the reduced allotment.
An apportioned gift directly mirrors qasam as a distributed share.
The live split-root image of humiliation by contempt supplies the opposite verdict that the human also misassigns.

structural_cues: The parallel 'as for the human when' constructions present expansion and constriction as matched trials.
The repeated 'he says, my Lord' exposes two verbal interpretations rather than two objective verdicts.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies testing, honor, constriction, apportioned provision, and humiliation; I infer that 89:5 names the disciplined faculty needed to refuse the equation share-size equals worth. Alternatively, 89:5 may close only the opening oath while the later pair independently corrects economic judgment.

changed_reading.before: Qasam is only the oath that precedes the question, and hijr only recognizes that oath.
changed_reading.after: Qasam also becomes the variable allotment under examination, and hijr is the capacity to withhold judgment until the allotment is read as a test rather than a status certificate.

context_deltas.mechanism: The social sequence juxtaposes a dependent cut off from protection and food-sharing with the consumption of inherited transfer, the gathering of dispersed property, and heart-bound accumulation. It is an anti-qasam: distinctions and owed shares are collapsed into appetite. Hijr becomes the limit that stops appropriation and preserves another's portion.

activation_trace.role: Apportioning a thing into shares supplies the distributive order violated by total consumption.
Keeping back by enclosure supplies the moral limit that protects another's share from appetite.
A child cut off from a protector supplies the exposed claimant whose portion requires guarding.
Urging toward an act supplies the missing social pressure to restore distribution.
Feeding another supplies the outward movement of a share toward need.
Consuming and taking wealth supplies the appetite that erases distributive boundaries.
Transfer from predecessor to heir supplies property already structured by succession and claims.
Gathering dispersed things into one supplies the anti-partition that absorbs distinct shares.
Love fixed in the heart supplies the affective force driving the boundary violation.
Accumulation until fullness supplies the totalizing endpoint of unrestrained acquisition.

structural_cues: 89:17-18 pair negated acts of protection and provision before 89:19-20 turn to collective consumption and attachment.
The intensive noun patterns in 89:19-20 make gathering and love feel iterative and excessive.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies severed protection, absent urging, feeding, inherited transfer, consumption, gathering, heart-attachment, and fullness; I infer that they enact a collapse of apportioned claims and that hijr would interrupt it. Alternatively, the passage may condemn greed without intentionally reactivating qasam as distribution.

changed_reading.before: The oath addresses a generally rational individual.
changed_reading.after: The oath addresses a distributive conscience: reason proves itself as hijr when it restrains appetite, preserves distinct claims, and moves a share toward the unprotected.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later human remembers when remembrance no longer produces advance and wishes to have sent something ahead for true benefit. This gives the focus deliberation a deadline: restraining reason must convert divided possibilities into prior action while the occasion is open.

activation_trace.role: A mind divided among courses supplies the unrealized decision point.
Restraining reason supplies the faculty meant to turn consideration into timely conduct.
Bringing something back after forgetfulness supplies cognition that arrives only after the decisive interval.
The live non-dominant image of occasion and time supplies an expired window behind the interrogative.
Advancing something forward supplies the action that deliberation failed to produce in time.
Life as benefit and good supplies the end toward which timely restraint should have directed action.

structural_cues: 89:23 places recollection beside an interrogative denial of its present utility.
89:24 answers that failed recollection with a retrospective wish to have advanced something earlier.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies recovered memory, a live split-root image of occasion, forward advance, and beneficial life; I infer that late cognition diagnoses an earlier failure of disciplined choice. Alternatively, the sequence can express general regret without reopening qasam's deliberative branch.

changed_reading.before: The possessor of hijr is whoever intellectually recognizes the oath's truth.
changed_reading.after: The possessor of hijr is whoever restrains divided impulses soon enough to advance a chosen good; recognition that waits until the decision boundary has closed is exposed as inert.

context_deltas.mechanism: The ending demolishes and levels built ground, repartitions agents into rows, imposes a binding enclosure, then addresses a settled self with return and entry into a sheltered enclosure. Hijr becomes a hinge among inward restraint, coercive restraint, and protective containment; qasam contributes the sorting of a collapsed whole into ordered outcomes.

activation_trace.role: Apportionment supplies the reordering of a collapsed whole into distinct rows and outcomes.
Keeping back by enclosure supplies the common boundary operation across restraint and binding.
An enclosed place supplies the spatial form into which the final movement enters.
Sheltered custody distinguishes protective containment from punitive restriction.
Pounding and demolishing to levelness removes inherited external boundaries.
Alignment on a level line supplies a new ordered partition after leveling.
The bond that fastens supplies coercive restraint imposed from outside.
Settled tranquility supplies an inwardly stabilized self that does not require coercive containment.
Return to what was supplies reversal from exposed judgment toward belonging.
Entry into an interior supplies boundary-crossing by permission rather than capture.
A garden sheltered by growth supplies protective enclosure as the terminal form of boundary.

structural_cues: The ending moves from repeated leveling and repeated rows to singular binding, then to repeated imperatives of return and entry.
Punitive fastening and welcomed entry are placed on opposite sides of the address to the settled self.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies demolition, rows, fastening, tranquility, return, entry, and a sheltered garden; I infer a transformation from failed self-boundary to external bond and from settled self-boundary to protective admission. Alternatively, these may be distinct eschatological scenes without one lexical circuit through hijr.

changed_reading.before: Hijr is a static label for intellect at the close of the opening oath.
changed_reading.after: Hijr becomes a dynamic boundary ethic: false enclosures collapse, absent inward restraint is answered by an external bond, and settled restraint culminates in admitted shelter.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because hijr in the focus construction most readily activates restrained reason, not a lap or wardship. It remains live because the focus inventory explicitly supplies sheltered custody while 89:17 supplies a child cut off from a custodian and 89:18 supplies feeding another. Downstream prose should present it as a secondary custodial resonance, not as a replacement gloss.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: حِجْرٍ at 89:5.6 directly carries sheltered custody, while قَسَمٌ at 89:5.4 can carry the protected person's apportioned share.

activation_trace.role: Lap and sheltered custody supply a protector-facing rather than purely intellectual hijr.
An apportioned share supplies what custody must preserve for the dependent.
The child cut off from a protector supplies the contextual absence that makes custodial hijr audible.
Feeding another supplies the concrete maintenance expected inside protective custody.

changed_reading.before: The oath is addressed to a person endowed with reason.
changed_reading.after: At a secondary register, the oath asks for a person capable of becoming a protective enclosure for the cut-off dependent and of preserving that dependent's share.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the facial-beauty branch of qasam is idiomatic and form-distant from the focus noun. It remains anchored in an explicit focus branch and is activated by paired and unpaired composition, proportioned formation, and aligned rows. Downstream prose should qualify it as a formal-aesthetic analogy, not claim that qasam lexically means beauty here.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: قَسَمٌ at 89:5.4 can image beauty apportioned across a face, and حِجْرٍ at 89:5.6 can image the perimeter that lets an arrangement appear as a whole.

activation_trace.role: Beauty apportioned across a face supplies a model of harmony produced by distributed features.
A circling outline supplies the frame within which distributed features become one composition.
Joining like to like supplies compositional symmetry.
The unpaired singular supplies asymmetry or a central remainder within the form.
Completed and balanced formation supplies a second image of proportioned appearance.
Alignment on level lines supplies the late formal echo of ordered distribution.

changed_reading.before: The question asks only whether the oath's referents convince reason.
changed_reading.after: The question may also ask whether the composition's apportioned form, balanced but not monotonously symmetric, is itself an evidentiary beauty visible to bounded attention.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the truce sense is an isolated qasama branch and is not the ordinary reading of the focus noun. It remains anchored through that supplied branch, hijr's sheltered custody, and the later sequence of return, mutual satisfaction, entry, and sheltered garden. Downstream prose should carry it only as a faint peace-making resonance, not as the primary semantic claim.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: قَسَمٌ at 89:5.4 supplies the qasama truce possibility and حِجْرٍ at 89:5.6 supplies close protection.

activation_trace.role: A qasama truce supplies a cessation of hostility as the outlier focus image.
Sheltered custody supplies the protected condition created after reconciliation.
Return to what was supplies movement out of estrangement.
Mutual satisfaction supplies the reciprocal peace relation rather than a one-sided reprieve.
Entry into an interior supplies restored access after return.
The garden sheltered by trees supplies the protected space in which the truce resonance terminates.

changed_reading.before: Qasam binds the hearer by an oath and hijr names the hearer's reason.
changed_reading.after: At the furthest live edge, the binding speech also foreshadows an armistice that ends estrangement and admits the restrained self into protected belonging.

strongest_changes: The counted opening strengthens qasam as an enacted partition of time and hijr as the faculty that detects boundaries.
The monumental sequence revises hijr into an inward limit contrasted with mastery of columns, stakes, and hard stone.
Provision and inheritance make qasam an allotment under moral test and hijr the restraint that prevents share-size from becoming status or appetite from absorbing another's claim.
The ending extends hijr across self-restraint, coercive binding, and protective enclosure without collapsing those forms into one.
summary.what_was_special: The two focus roots behaved as a reusable operator across temporal, architectural, economic, cognitive, and custodial domains: qasam separates or binds, while hijr determines whether the resulting boundary is perceived, violated, imposed, or made protective. The strongest readings coexist with branch-distant formal-beauty and truce resonances rather than being forced into one interpretation.
remaining_uncertainties: It remains uncertain whether later provision and inheritance intentionally reactivate qasam's apportionment branch or merely make that branch abductively productive.
The external-stone versus inner-restraint antithesis is strong, but the exact degree of lexical play intended by the focus construction cannot be fixed from the packet.
The custodial, formal-beauty, truce, and final enclosure circuits depend on reader-supplied cross-domain arrows and should remain explicitly exploratory.
